query:
SELECT state_code, district, candidate1_name, candidate1_party, candidate1_votes, candidate1_pct,
       candidate2_name, candidate2_party, candidate2_votes, candidate2_pct,
       reporting_pct, status, called_winner, called_party
FROM house_races
WHERE state_code IN ('WV', 'NE')
ORDER BY state_code, district;
